rationale: T044 closes the local public-content runtime gate: real-app E2E 4/4, a11y 4/4, build 3/3 with 80 static pages, and launch-evidence validation passed. Overall completion is not justified. worker_package.objective: Implement and verify the Paper & Slate design-system and visual-foundation vertical slice: replace the design-system marker with semantic tokens, required typography, light/dark themes, source-owned primitives, and responsive public/docs shell wiring using the supplied logo and visual references. Cover 390px layouts, reduced motion, dark-logo selection, and representative visual/a11y regression evidence. Do not change content data, docs ingestion, search providers, hardening/operations, or external activation.
stop_if: Any write is needed outside allowed_files.

The work requires changing content registries/routes, docs-ingestion/source artifacts, generated docs, search-provider code or configuration, middleware/CSP, Docker/Tower/monitoring files, credentials, providers, or production activation.
A missing font, image, license, or visual reference would require inventing provenance or altering supplied artwork.
A required verification command fails twice for the same in-scope cause.
Visual or browser verification reveals functional, accessibility, responsive, or dark-mode regressions that require weakening existing assertions.
The design-system package cannot be wired without changing unrelated feature or data behavior.
